title: Momo / 墨墨 — FX
description: Standalone skill FX for Black Panda 墨熊貓. Travel west. Evolve FX included.

assets.note: Dust + bamboo-leaf puff left behind the rolling panda (spawn at the panda origin every 3–4 cast frames; does not move).
Jade impact star when the rolling panda hits a zombie (knockback). Centre on contact point.

Crescent sweep in front (west) of the panda, top → bottom, reach ≈ 50 px from the pivot (≈ 100 px wide arc). Melee AoE + knockback on frames 1–4. Origin = swing pivot (place at the panda chest). Bamboo leaves fly off the edge.

AoE shockwave around the panda: radius ≈ 110 px (x) × 37 px (y ground ellipse). Origin = ground under the panda. Frames 0–3 charge; damage + knockback when the ring passes (frames 4–9); bamboo shards fly outward.
Form-change burst. Origin = pet feet (y=118). Play over the pet; swap the pet texture on frame 6 (the flash).
